name: The flat's corridor between the bedrooms (Singapore): test level eval2, Packing Day from scratch; from the owner's photograph of 24 Oct 2026, not kept
setting: Cosy and plain: a short narrow corridor in a Singapore flat on a rainy December afternoon, empty of people.
palette: the walls are plain white, with no painted band; the band line is only the height of a door handle, 36% of the way up the back wall from the floor; the floor is pale stone tiles with a faint sheen; dark honey-coloured wooden doors and frames
box: a narrow deep box in one-point perspective: a back wall only as wide as a corridor, long side walls, a thin strip of ceiling with one small round light, a floor band
light: no window of its own: a small round ceiling light, and grey daylight reaching in from the dining end at the far end of the corridor and through the two open bedroom doors

c1.name: the children's door (north), the end of the corridor
c1.light: grey daylight comes out of the open doorway itself, from the children's window beyond; the corridor walls either side are lit by the ceiling light

objects.label: the children's open door
objects.text: at the end of the corridor, a dark wooden door standing open and through the doorway a glimpse of the children's room: a white bunk bed's end covered in tiny stickers, a grey rug, grey daylight
objects.size: the door reaches almost to the ceiling strip

c2.name: Mary's door (east), the first on the left walking in
c2.light: grey daylight comes out of Mary's open doorway at the left, from her window beyond; the rest of the wall is lit by the ceiling light

objects.label: framed picture
objects.text: a small framed picture with a dark frame on the white wall at the left, at a grown-up's eye height

objects.label: Mary's open door
objects.text: Mary's door standing open: a dark wooden door and frame, and through the doorway a glimpse of her room: the end of a grey sofa, a striped rug, grey daylight
objects.size: the door reaches almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: a second door frame, closed
objects.text: further along at the right, a second dark wooden door, closed, with a brass handle
objects.size: the door reaches almost to the ceiling strip

c3.name: the double doors (south), the far end of the corridor and the turn to the dining end
c3.light: grey daylight comes round the corner from the dining end at the right, bright on the stone floor there; the double doors at the end are in softer ceiling light

objects.label: closed double doors
objects.text: at the end of the corridor, a pair of tall dark wooden double doors, closed, with two small brass handles meeting in the middle
objects.size: reaching almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: the turn to the dining end
objects.text: at the right the corridor opens into the dining end: bright grey daylight, the corner of a pine dining table and a wooden chair, a white wall beyond
objects.size: an opening the full height of the wall

c4.name: the wall opposite Mary's door (west)
c4.light: lit by the ceiling light, with grey daylight from Mary's doorway behind the viewer

objects.label: a light switch
objects.text: a single white light switch on the plain white wall at a grown-up's shoulder height

objects.label: plain wall and skirting
objects.text: a plain white wall with a low white skirting board, nothing else on it
